properties.site-address: Stannington Nurseries Tea Room, Stannington Station
properties.notes: Redevelopment of tea room buildings and associated land at Stannington Station. Planning permission has been granted for development of 34 homes (16/03693/FUL). This is yet to commence but is expected to be delivered within the next 5 years. A previous outline consent for 27 homes was approved prior to this (15/01760/OUT). The latest full permission relates to a larger site than the initial outline consent.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
